objective: Prospective targeted genotype-level aggregation on previously unexamined HG005 chr20 reads after MP35 development. Preserve read-level uncertainty; do not reinterpret genotype concordance as per-molecule truth.
reference: Exact chr20 sequence from ENA MD5 service, bound to CRAM SQ length and M5 before selection. Preserve published CRAI and independently derived header-shift repair from MP35; require successful integrity-checked decoding.
eligibility: HG002 PASS simple biallelic chr20 indels2-30nt, minimum allele length1, ACGT. Entire500bp flanks within HG005 confident BED, exact REF match. Positive: sole overlapping HG005 VCF record is exact same allele with1/1 or1|1 PASS. Negative: no HG005 VCF record overlaps context. All other cases excluded, not errors.
regional_split: Region=floor(zero_based_position/1000000); calibration if first byte SHA256(MP36_REGION|chr20|region) is even, otherwise test. Exclude positions within100000bp of every1Mb region boundary. Within each100kb bin retain only lowest SHA256(MP36_LOCUS|chr20|pos|ref|alt) eligible candidate, regardless class. Then within each partition/class rank by same hash and take first32. Require32 positives and32 negatives per partition without relaxation. No region shared between partitions. Report actual count of regions.
reads: Primary MAPQ>=20, nonduplicate/nonQCfail, uniquely named per locus; VCF anchor maps to a query base; at least150 actual query bases on each side; ACGT observed300nt. For test, exclude any read ID retained in calibration before ranking. Hash-rank remaining IDs and retain first20; minimum10/site, no substitute loci. Require zero retained calibration/test read-ID overlap. Preserve all excluded counts, coordinates, CIGAR, source hashes and orientation.
templates_and_views: Canonical REF/ALT with500bp flanks. Same actual query produces nested150/300nt windows centered on anchor. Exact minimum unit edit distance to positive template substrings, cap600. No imputed bases.
new_score: At each evaluable locus and candidate allele, median across retained reads of(score_allele - min_candidate_score) for each length. Store twice the median exactly as integer. This is a locus-level score, not a per-read certificate.
calibration: For each calibration1Mb region, maximum expected-genotype doubled-median score across its evaluable selected loci. One split-conformal threshold per length with alpha0.05, rank ceil((n_regions+1)*0.95). Require>=19 evaluable calibration regions; otherwise report insufficient calibration and do not evaluate test. Freeze thresholds and retained calibration read IDs before test.
comparator: Transport frozen MP35 read rule: best absolute<=59 at150 or<=118 at300; relative score<=4. A locus call requires>=80% retained reads with the same singleton; else abstain. No recalibration of comparator.
primary: 300nt locus-level aggregation versus transported300nt read-consensus comparator on the same64 planned test loci. Descriptive success requires more correct singleton locus calls, no more discordant locus calls, expected label coverage>=95% over all64 planned sites with non-evaluable treated unresolved, and zero retained calibration/test read-ID overlap. All confusion cells and abstentions retained. No universal accuracy or population-effect inference.
secondary: 150nt aggregation, within-rule150/300 comparisons, empirical test-region coverage and read-ID overlap within regions. Candidate class and size strata, absolute fit scores and failures reported. No selection after test results.
limitations: One public HG005 sample and one ONT flowcell; inherited benchmark and mapping assumptions. Acquisition independent of2021 benchmark, not independent laboratories in this work. Region-block exchangeability is an assumption. Balanced candidate panel does not estimate population PPV or de novo discovery sensitivity.
runtime: Colab CPU viaCLI, batches8 loci, atomic source-bound checkpoints persisted per batch to Drive. Max24h; report incomplete if exceeded. Independent Edlib distance recount and second coordinate extraction, read-ID/region partition audits before adjudication. Manuscripts private.
